relationships.evidence_quote: Likewise, NaBu reduced the levels of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), haemoglobin content and the number of blood vessels, suggesting diminished angiogenesis (Figure 5).

relationships.subject: sodium butyrate
relationships.evidence_quote: A significant reduction in TGF‐β1 levels (50%) within the implant was observed in the treated group compared with the levels in control implants (Figure 6e).

relationships.subject: sodium butyrate
relationships.evidence_quote: The treatment reduced production of the inflammatory cytokines TNF‐α, CXCL1 and CCL2 by ∼50%.

relationships.subject: sodium butyrate
relationships.evidence_quote: Implants of NaBu‐treated animals showed a significant reduction in the nuclear‐to‐cytoplasmic ratio of the NF‐κB heterodimer, which consists of the proteins p65 and p50 (Figure 4), as revealed by Western blot analysis.

key_findings: Oral sodium butyrate reduced inflammation, angiogenesis (VEGF) and fibrogenesis (TGF-β1) in mouse intraperitoneal sponge implants.
